beats.narration_en: This low concrete wall along the highway is called a Jersey barrier.
Hit a flat wall at an angle, and the car just stops dead.
This barrier's face isn't flat. It's angled, like a ramp.
A wheel that hits it climbs the slope instead of digging in.
That lifts the car just enough to steer it back into its lane.
One curve in a concrete wall keeps cars from becoming projectiles.
